item.title: Arvind Fashions to buy Flipkart’s 31.25% stake in Arvind Youth Brands for Rs 135 crore
item.description: New Delhi: Arvind Fashions on Monday said it will acquire Flipkart group's 31.25% stake in Arvind Youth Brands for Rs 135 crore. Arvind Youth Brands (AYBPL) is currently engaged in the business of wholesale and retail of apparel and accessories under the brand name 'Flying Machine'. It had a turnover of Rs 432.16 crore in the financial year ended March 31, 2025, the company said in a regulatory filing. item.title: Marketing trends 2025: AI changed discovery and ended siloed digital marketing
item.description: New Delhi: 2025 will be remembered as the year marketing fundamentally reset itself. AI reshaped how discovery works, blurred the lines between creativity and performance, and forced brands to abandon fragmented execution in favour of integrated systems built for relevance and outcomes. At the same time, audiences became sharper gatekeepers of their attention, rewarding clarity and intent over volume and noise. item.description: New Delhi: Samsung Electronics has announced plans to integrate Google Photos into its Samsung AI TV lineup, with features expected to roll out from 2026. item.title: DS Group rolls out digital film and print creative to recognise India’s women farmers
item.description: New Delhi: Dharampal Satyapal Group (DS Group) has extended its #SaluteTheFarmHER initiative with a new digital film and print-led campaign to recognise the contribution of women farmers across India on the occasion of National Farmers’ Day. item.title: Saurabh Jain joins Cosmo First as CEO of Zigly and Head of Corporate Development
item.description: New Delhi: Cosmo First has appointed Saurabh Jain as Chief Executive Officer of its pet care division, Zigly, and Head of Corporate Development. The company has business interests spanning films, sheets and containers, pet care, consumer products and specialty chemicals. In his role as CEO of Zigly, Jain will oversee the pet care business and its expansion.
